hints.title: Bitmask of Taken Courses
hints.text: Represent the subset of taken courses using an integer mask where bit i set means course i has been completed.

hints.title: Available Courses Filter
hints.text: A course i can be taken if it is not yet taken and all its prerequisite courses are contained in the current mask.

hints.title: Submask Transitions
hints.text: From all available courses, try all combinations of up to k courses to take in the next semester.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy selection of courses fails because choosing an unconstrained course early may block prerequisites on the critical path.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask dynamic programming explores all 2^N states with submask transitions within reasonable limits for N <= 15.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes greedy topological sorting fails here and formulates exact bitmask dynamic programming.
complexity.notes: NP-hard problem variant requiring exponential search.
